book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Xel neil wou Yesu en dee
Xel Parisi me xel Sadyusi lam wou Yesu me wo axeing wou e me teling wou bei e talex dee wei tyoung gheyapu nei ti wou xel.
Moxo neil elox bei, “Gyeik soukeing lam, eno laxap wo gyand om xam ghe neimbei ‘Inye tyek bo nimza,’

de satiboukeing lul eno xam ghe neimbei, ‘De wangwei sayeiv nam a tyip, me na siing lek tyoung me wo gyand ekom laxap wo xeingak me sevun tyoung, woyom xel woulek bei laweeng tyek na tyip me luing detei.’ Xam ghe mi wei dee wei tyoung me ghe woulek ewo nimza, ekom nambei nya xam seng woulek dee wei bouk ti gweimbeeng ne yo.

Xel moux alis vex nilul wei bouk tine wei mi toung demind wou Anutu yo eno xel embei gyei dee wei lulvako yo, ekom xel se teyei bei gyei dee ti qe dee wei poropet Yona yo.” Woyom Yesu la veil xel me la.
Qayeeng pakeing wei Yis wei xel Parisi me Sadyusiyeiw o
Gyeik xel betiyeing la is Yesu me la lounyeing nge loxalu, xel naleind ma me se qou belet ti.
Yesu neil wou xel, “Xam ghe gweiteyei xow en yis wei xel Parisi me Sadyusiyeiw o.”
Xel neil tine eivek ama senghoing me neil, “En inye nambei xey se qou belet ti.”
Yesu woulek xel xe qayeeng wei xel di luklek on om neil wou xel, “Xam xe wongeingis on nayaka. Nambei nya xam ghe di pyalek ama en ingwei belet ma yo?
Beip xam seng ghei woulek? Beip xam seng wou naleimim en belet lim wei xel xomaxoneing 5,000 ya yo, me pasik vamva wei xam ghe qekuwou yo?
O belet lim yuw wou xel 4,000, me pasik vamva wei xam ghe qekuwou yo?
Nambei nya xam seng woulek bei a se di luk wou xam en belet om a neil qayeeng tine wou xam? Ekom xam ghe gweiteyei xow en yis wei xel Parisi me Sadyusiyeiw o.”
Woyom xel woulek bei moxo se di teling xel bei xel gyei xow teyei en yis wei xel mi toung eivek belet o, qe en teyoxeing wei xel Parisi me Sadyusiyeiw o.
Petele neil Kilisi teyei
Yesu la eivek tembuing danghei wei Sisalia Pilipai eno moxo teling wou e xe xel betiyeing, “Xel xomaxoneing mi neil embei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux on eti?”
Xel neil elox bei, “Xel valu mi neil embei wa Yoan lipekeing. De valu mi neil embei wa Eliya, me valu mi neil embei wa Yelemia o tambiy wei poropet o ti.”
Om moxo teling xel, “ekom xam ghe neimbei ay eti?”
Simon Petele lewexe, “Wang on Kilisi, Anutu mapieing neu moux.”
Yesu neil elox, “Simon Yona neu, mata e nak wou wang, en xomaxoneing ti se neil inye teyei wou wang, qe inye lam wou Mang wei toundei tyoung gheyapu nei.
De a neil wou wang bei wang on Petele qes bei qakous, me lek qakous tine tyek a bong a xe xel wongeingis bo ngenong, me bale nikanzek lek e de nikanzek wei meyeing eno tyek se nam lelolexe inyon.

Tyek am bong ki wei tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei eno wou wang, om vati wei wambei tup lek tembuing eno tyek Anutu na tup anghei tyoung gheyapu nei, de vati wei wa tul lek tembuing ne eno tyek Anutu na tul veil anghei tyoung gheyapu nei.”
Woyom moxo peti e xe xel betiyeing bei xel se neilteyei bei e Kilisi.
Yesu neil e xe meyeing teyei ti myaxeeng

Qandi eivek bouk kayon eno Yesu neilteyei wou e xe xel betiyeing bei tyek na Yerusalem me na qou myavanei ngenong lek xel teivateiv me xel lumuki leitata me xel putoung wei petieing o memend, me xel nyeis e mey de lek bouk yal eno moxo tyek qandi lek veil meyeing.
Om Petele qou moxo me la nenyawes me luk niseikeing atax wou e, “Tambiy Ngandoung, se teyei ti! Lul tine tyek se belup wou wang!”
Yesu pekwi ma me neil wou Petele, “Sandang, la a deming! Wambei bale zeyi ay. Wa lum on se betiwou lulul wei Anutu yo, qe lulul wei xomaxoneing o.”
Woyom Yesu neil wou e xe xel betiyeing, “Wangwei tambiy ti embei betiwou ay, ond e dax xow vun dom qalei e xe xax pepeeng me betiwou ay.
En wangwei xelti embei zeimaxoun e xe mapieing yond tyek na saing veil, ekom xelti embei saing e xe mapieing en ay eno tyek na qou e xe mapieing.
Wangwei tambiy ti e qou lul dalus wei tembuing sapa ne yo, dom na saing ning mapieing, on tyek na qou lul nimza vati? Moux on tyek bo xouveing vati zeyi ning nu pieing?
En Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek nam is Ma xe xeiyaing ngandoung is e xe xel angela, de woyom moxo tyek bong xouveing wou xel titi teyei lek vati wei xel mi wong o.
A neil wou xam zonghek, xel valu wei toukale inye eno tyek se daxe meyeing atax, qe ka xel gyei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux nam eivek e xe tete lalei le.”
